final: WITH matched AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.PT, l.ALB - l.TP AS albumin_minus_protein FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID), patient_sex_groups AS (SELECT ID, SEX, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(albumin_minus_protein) AS avg_albumin_minus_protein FROM matched GROUP BY ID, SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS overall_avg_pt FROM patient_sex_groups), paired AS (SELECT g.SEX, g.avg_pt, g.avg_albumin_minus_protein, g.avg_pt - o.overall_avg_pt AS pt_difference FROM patient_sex_groups AS g JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_avg_pt IS NOT NULL) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_group_avg_pt, AVG(avg_albumin_minus_protein) AS avg_group_avg_albumin_minus_protein, AVG(pt_difference) AS avg_pt_difference FROM paired GROUP BY SEX
